image_description: A weathered, ancient bronze breastplate (cuirass) displayed on a white museum pedestal. The armor features anatomical molding to simulate pectoral and abdominal muscles. It is heavily patinated with green verdigris and brown oxidation spots, indicating age. Small attachment loops are visible along the edges. The background is a neutral beige wall, typical of a gallery setting.
